gates.name: Preview and Production Isolation
gates.requirement: Preview environments are blocked from connecting to production Supabase project abhadytskhgwkrlmceew; fail-closed behavior verified
gates.testMethod: lib/preview-isolation.ts inspection + Unit tests in tests/unit/preview-isolation.test.ts

gates.name: Secrets and Environment Security
gates.requirement: No secrets in client bundle or Git history, least-privilege separation between MONITOR_SECRET and CRON_SECRET

gates.actualResult: Gitleaks clean. check:bundle clean. Live curl simulation with MONITOR_SECRET returns 403 FORBIDDEN
gates.expectedResult: Secrets isolated, least-privilege enforced
gates.evidence: GitHub Actions Run 41500580745 + Live curl probe to /api/jobs/monitor
gates.limitations: Secrets stored in Vercel sensitive environment variables

gates.name: Database Migration Integrity
gates.requirement: All 47 repo migration files match applied schema migrations in live Supabase production DB without drift
gates.testMethod: SQL comparison query between supabase/migrations/*.sql and supabase_migrations.schema_migrations
gates.actualResult: Exact 47 applied migrations (20261011000000 through 20261058000000). Zero missing, zero pending
gates.expectedResult: 100% migration parity between repo and production DB
gates.limitations: Live schema on Supabase Frankfurt eu-central-1

gates.name: Multi-Tenant Isolation and RLS
gates.requirement: Row Level Security enabled and enforced on all tables, cross-tenant isolation verified, zero security advisor warnings
gates.testMethod: Supabase Security Advisor API + pgTAP tests + Playwright multi-tenant tests
gates.actualResult: Security advisor returns 0 WARN / 0 ERROR. RLS enabled on all public tables. SECURITY DEFINER restricted to private schema
gates.expectedResult: Zero unauthorized cross-tenant data access
gates.limitations: Service role key accesses all tenants by design for background jobs

gates.testMethod: Supabase Management API inspect + Unit tests in auth-schemas.test.ts and auth-templates.test.ts

gates.expectedResult: Secure auth pipeline with breached password defense
gates.evidence: Supabase security advisor check (leaked passwords check clear)
gates.limitations: Requires TOTP authenticator app for MFA

gates.name: Public Booking Engine
gates.requirement: Accurate slot availability, operating hours, Israel timezone handling, zero double-bookings under concurrent load
gates.testMethod: PostgreSQL exclusion constraint tstzrange && + Playwright 100-request concurrent stress test
gates.actualResult: Zero overlapping appointments created. Deadlock detection maps to 409 slot_taken cleanly
gates.expectedResult: Mathematical double-booking prevention at DB tier
gates.evidence: public.appointments exclusion constraint + Playwright concurrency test run
gates.limitations: Lead time and booking horizon enforced server-side

gates.name: Customer Lifecycle
gates.requirement: Book, confirmation email, customer management link with HMAC token, cancel within notice window, reschedule, token expiration
gates.testMethod: Unit tests in booking-token.test.ts + Playwright customer journey tests
gates.actualResult: 10/10 booking-token tests passed. Customer token verifies expiration (appointment + 7d) and HMAC integrity
gates.expectedResult: Full customer self-service journey without password requirement
gates.limitations: Customer actions limited to appointment scope

gates.expectedResult: End-to-end business operations without platform operator manual intervention
